acceptanceCriteria: The V2 document remains FOUNDER_REVIEW_DRAFT_NON_MUTATING source direction.
Programme direction is accepted only through this controlling wrapper.
Acceptance is subject to CHAMP-S1-A01 through CHAMP-S1-A06.
The Master Truth Amendment is accepted, separate, additive and product-local.
Programme precedence and conflict rules are machine-readable.
The freeze SHA and verified Git tree are authoritative while the erroneous supplied tree is preserved historically.
No Stage B authority is granted.
No product, Router, WEOS or chatbot-engine source is changed.
Documentation branch, commit and draft-PR transactions require exact Stage 0 authority.
No runtime, merge or production deployment authority is granted.
Every future agent is directed to the programme index before work.
A documentation receipt lists inputs, decisions, changed files, tests, approvals and rollback.
rollback: Remove the documentation-only files or revert the documentation commit. Product runtime must remain unchanged.
